mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, take my temperature, and sit at the edge of the bed until the fogginess settles.
mara.intention: Assess how I feel before making decisions and avoid starting the day too quickly.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into lounge clothes, and leave the workout clothes and running shoes alone.
mara.intention: Keep the morning manageable and conserve energy.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea with lemon and honey, carry the mug to the kitchen island, and eat toast with a little butter.
mara.intention: Settle my stomach and get some food in before taking anything else.

mara.activity: Carry the mug and plate to the sink, rinse them, and leave the kitchen orderly before returning to bed.
mara.intention: Do one small reset without turning it into a chore.

mara.activity: Send a short message cancelling the studio day and site commitments, flagging only the most urgent presentation question.
mara.intention: Protect the day for recovery while keeping the studio informed.

mara.activity: Rest in bed with the curtains partly open, keeping water and my phone nearby, and doze if I can.
mara.intention: Let the illness run its course instead of spending energy on work.

mara.activity: Make another small mug of ginger tea and carry it to the living room, then eat yogurt and a banana at the coffee table.
mara.intention: Have a gentle lunch without preparing anything demanding.

mara.activity: Sleep or doze on the sectional with the lights soft, leaving the phone face down on the coffee table.
mara.intention: Recover after eating and keep stimulation low.

mara.activity: Check messages once and answer only anything genuinely urgent, then leave the phone on the living room sideboard.
mara.intention: Maintain a small connection to work without reopening the whole workday.

mara.activity: Rest on the sectional with my feet up and listen to a quiet podcast, accepting help if Julian checks in.
mara.intention: Stay comfortable and avoid making decisions while foggy.

mara.activity: Take cold medicine according to the label, drink water, and sit quietly before deciding whether I have enough energy to eat.
mara.intention: Manage symptoms carefully rather than pushing through them.

mara.activity: Make scrambled eggs and toast at the island, carrying the plate and water glass to the living room rather than setting a formal dinner.
mara.intention: Prepare the simplest nourishing dinner while Julian is working his usual evening service.

mara.activity: Carry the plate and glass back to the kitchen, rinse them, and wipe the island once.
mara.intention: Leave only a small amount of cleanup for later.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional with the lights low, keeping tissues and water within reach.
mara.intention: Replace my normal cooking and work evening with quiet recovery.

mara.activity: Take a warm, brief shower, put on my evening sweater and lounge pants, and leave the towel in the bathroom to dry.
mara.intention: Get comfortable for the night without tiring myself out.

mara.activity: Make a final small mug of ginger tea and carry it to the bedroom with water.
mara.intention: Soothe my throat and prepare for sleep.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and take the tea and water to the bed.
mara.intention: Finish the day gently and avoid another trip once settled.

mara.activity: Read a few pages in bed, then put my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand and set the phone beside them.
mara.intention: Wind down without checking work again.

mara.activity: Turn off the light, stay warm, and sleep.
mara.intention: Give my body a full night for recovery.

julian.activity: Wake quietly, wash, brush my teeth, and get dressed in comfortable clothes. I move carefully around the bedroom and check on Mara without waking her fully.
julian.intention: Start the day quietly and make sure Mara is comfortable.

julian.activity: Carry a water glass from the kitchen to the bedroom and leave it within Mara’s reach. I sit briefly nearby, speak softly, and avoid pressing her to eat or talk.
julian.intention: Offer practical care while letting Mara rest.

julian.activity: Make coffee and a very simple breakfast. I carry the coffee beans, mug, milk, banana, and a water glass to the kitchen island, grind the beans quietly, and eat while checking the Tuesday delivery and prep notes.
julian.intention: Have enough food and caffeine for the workday without making a production of breakfast.

julian.activity: Rinse the mug and glass, wipe the island, and check on Mara once more. I leave a fresh water glass nearby and send a brief message to the restaurant manager confirming I will be in for prep and remain reachable.
julian.intention: Leave the house organized and make sure work coverage is clear.

julian.activity: Get ready for the restaurant. I change into work trousers, a restaurant shirt, kitchen clogs, and chef jacket, pack my backpack, fill my thermos, and carry my keys from the piano’s middle shelf.
julian.intention: Prepare efficiently while keeping the morning quiet for Mara.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, the supplier delivery, and kitchen management. I check produce and storage, organize the prep list, taste sauces, and coordinate the kitchen while keeping my phone available for Mara.
julian.intention: Run prep carefully and stay available if Mara needs me.

julian.activity: Take a quiet break after prep, drink from the thermos, and check messages. I call home briefly rather than improvising if Mara sounds worse, then confirm the evening service plan with the manager.
julian.intention: Reset before service and remain practically connected to home.

julian.activity: Review the dinner mise en place and service notes, eat a small staff meal, and make sure the kitchen is ready before the doors open.
julian.intention: Set up a steady service so I do not have to make unnecessary decisions later.

julian.activity: Work dinner service and closing duties. I cook through service, manage the pass, finish the closing checklist, and keep my phone accessible for any urgent message from Mara.
julian.intention: Complete the long service safely and get home without lingering afterward.

julian.activity: Return home, put my keys on the piano’s middle shelf, set my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, and bring the thermos to the kitchen beside the sink. I check quietly that Mara is settled without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Come home gently and confirm Mara is all right.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, dry off, and change into sleep clothes. I leave the towel in the bathroom to dry and keep the lights low.
julian.intention: Let the service leave my body and move toward sleep.

julian.activity: Eat a small serving of yogurt and drink water from the refrigerator instead of cooking. I rinse the bowl and glass and leave them beside the sink.
julian.intention: Have something gentle before bed with no extra decisions.

julian.activity: Brush my teeth, carry my phone to the main bedroom nightstand, plug it in, and get into bed beside Mara without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Sleep close by while keeping the phone available if Mara needs help.
